AI Overview
War of Sticks is a 2D real-time strategy (RTS) and tower defense game developed by Shoom Games (and published on mobile by Pavlo Sich) where you command an army of stickmen to liberate your people from the oppressive Red Empire. 
Apple
 +1
Core Gameplay & Mechanics
Resource Management: Train and send miners to dig for gold and stones. Use these resources to fund your army, construct defense towers, and upgrade units. 
Army Units: Build a balanced force consisting of roles like miners, shielders, archers, barbarians/berserkers, and wizards. 
Campaign & Progression: Fight through a series of increasingly difficult levels and islands (the mobile version features a 50-level campaign with Normal, Hard, and Impossible difficulties). 
Apple
 +2
Controls: Tap or click to train units, build structures, and trigger attacks across the battlefield. 
Where to Play
Browser / PC: You can play it for free on browser-based gaming platforms like Poki and CrazyGames.
Mobile: Available as a free download on the Apple App Store for iOS (War of Sticks App) and Google Play for Android.
